summary: Defines a NETCONF capability that adds partial lock and unlock operations. Standard NETCONF can only lock an entire configuration datastore, but sometimes only parts need to be locked. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Instead of locking the whole classroom while you fix one desk, this lets you put a lock on just that desk, so others can work on the rest.

questions: how to lock part of a netconf datastore
what is the netconf partial lock rpc
